messages:
carol: heads-up — planning a nighttime deploy for llm-route v3 in eu-west. We want a conservative feature-flag ramp with a surge-decay safety lane and session-stickiness pin for existing users. Posting the plan here for sign-off and ops handoff.

deploybot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-24 23:00 UTC. Planned actions: enable `llm-route.v3` via feature flag with stepped ramp, session pin for active sessions, and automatic decay backoff on anomalies. Example command (runbook): `/deploybot ff apply --name=llm-route-v3 --steps=5,20,100 --decay-window=15m --pin=cohorts=A,B --monitor=telemetry:llmroute`

mike: LGTM. Quick question — what exactly does `decay-window=15m` do in practice?

anya: Decay explanation: if an anomaly (error-rate or latency breach) is detected in a 5m sliding window, the system will step down to the previous traffic step and hold for the decay window (15m) before attempting to ramp again. We only auto-step down — manual rollback option still exists. Thresholds: error-rate delta > +3% absolute OR p99 latency > +150% of baseline triggers backoff.

sre_oncall: I'll be onwatch for the first 30m. I'll also enable additional tracing for `llmroute` and set alerts: error-rate >0.5% sustained for 5m, and p99 > 500ms. I'll open a short-lived dashboard.

devops: Note: we'll pin v2 for cohorts A and B for 1 hour post-ramp start to keep a clean rollback path (cohorts pinned to v2 session affinity). Unpin strategy: auto-unpin only after 30m of stable metrics at 100% or via manual approval.

carol: release notes draft: "llm-route v3 staged rollout with surge-decay backoff and session-stickiness pin for cohorts A/B. Canary monitoring & rollback thresholds applied." Adding runbook commands to the release doc.

mike: runbook snippet (please paste into the release doc):
```
# deploybot flag ramp example
/deploybot ff apply --name=llm-route-v3 --steps=5,20,100 --decay-window=15m --pin=cohorts=A,B --monitor=telemetry:llmroute
```

anya: I'll add the fallback policy: if GPU util > 70% or any capacity alerts fire, deploybot will route traffic back to v2 and notify #eng-oncall. Also adding a postmortem checklist in case we see cascading retries.

sre_oncall: Adding operational knobs: circuit-breaker at 60% GPU util with 2-min throttle, and autoswitch to v2 if REQ_ERRORS > 2x baseline for 3m. I'll post the short dashboard link once it's up.

carol: rollback plan: in the event of major spikes run `/deploybot ff set llm-route-v3 0` to disable and then unpin cohorts. After disabling we validate v2 health for 15m before closing the incident. Keep this thread for live updates during the window. :thumbsup:
